scope.production_boundary: kernel component-runner and eight generic substrate mechanisms
scope.interpretation: A native mechanism success means only that opaque bytes were transported or persisted. It is not a factory-domain decision. Domain document validation, approval, exchange replay policy and workflow meaning remain component responsibilities. Approval evidence below executes the compiled policy component through a focused Wasmtime adapter; the adapter is not a production native policy substitute.

native_tcb_inventory.binding: Exact final machine inventory bytes; native_boundary verifies every reachable native source, fixture, lockfile, operator-capacity example and normative WIT closure named by that inventory.

receipt_assertions.applies_to: every adversarial case that reaches component invocation
receipt_assertions.request_digest: sha256 of the exact serialized run request
receipt_assertions.outcome_digest: sha256 of the exact terminal outcome
receipt_assertions.clock: fixed injected mechanism time for both start and finish
receipt_assertions.pre_admission_failures: Rejected before invocation; no run operation or run receipt exists.

cases.stimulus: Seven equal-authority inputs spanning empty bytes, factory-looking JSON and tokens, invalid UTF-8, NULs, traversal/SQL-looking text, 257 repeated bytes and malformed JSON.
cases.observed: All selected the same component authority/executable provenance, same grant/limit envelope and succeeded with exact byte-for-byte output. Only content/request/outcome digests varied.

cases.stimulus: 65-byte blob under a 64-byte per-item capacity.
cases.observed: Rejected before persistence with quota-exceeded.

cases.stimulus: Input blob reference substituted with a validly shaped but absent all-zero SHA-256 digest.
cases.observed: Start rejected with not-found before component invocation.

cases.stimulus: Same echo task and opaque input without the blob-store grant.
cases.observed: Component run completed rejected/not-granted with a content-bound failure receipt.

cases.stimulus: Admitted component requested an Ed25519 signature through an exact opaque handle.
cases.observed: Component received only public key ID and 64-byte signature. Host PKCS#8 bytes occurred only in the owner-only native state file and were absent from output blobs, completion, receipt and provenance serialization.

cases.stimulus: Disabled HTTP request carried an opaque credential handle; a raw-secret sentinel was retained only by the test.
cases.observed: Failure did not reflect the handle or secret, and disabled transport persisted neither. This bounded profile has no credential-byte ingestion API.

cases.stimulus: Admitted task executed wasm unreachable.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome failed/component-failed with truthful run receipt; no native fallback ran.

cases.stimulus: Admitted task entered an infinite spin loop under 100000 fuel.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome exhausted/execution-exhausted with truthful run receipt.

cases.stimulus: Admitted task attempted a greater-than-32-MiB allocation under a 4-MiB store memory limit.
cases.observed: Memory growth trapped; terminal outcome failed/component-failed with truthful run receipt.

cases.stimulus: Task returned a verified 4096-byte blob reference under a 128-byte requested output bound.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome exhausted/limit-exceeded with truthful run receipt.

cases.stimulus: Task returned an all-zero, validly shaped SHA-256 blob reference not present in content storage.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome failed/not-found with truthful run receipt.

cases.stimulus: Non-Wasm bytes supplied under their actual digest.
cases.observed: Admission rejected the bytes as not a Component Model component.

cases.stimulus: Valid component bytes supplied under a different expected digest.
cases.observed: Admission rejected with ComponentDigestMismatch before storage or invocation.

cases.stimulus: Valid Component Model fixture mutated to import wasm-biotic:factory/evil-store@0.1.0.
cases.observed: Fixed task linker could not instantiate it; terminal outcome failed/component-failed with truthful run receipt. Manifest-bound admission separately rejects non-substrate residual imports.

cases.stimulus: Task returned bytes ff 00 7b 0a with media type application/json.
cases.observed: Substrate preserved exact opaque bytes and did not parse or bless domain meaning. A factory policy component remains responsible for rejecting malformed domain documents.

cases.stimulus: Task granted namespace alpha attempted a mutation in outside-grant.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome rejected/not-granted; no mutation was visible in alpha and the operator-level outside-grant read was independently out-of-scope.

cases.stimulus: Task attempted a 4096-byte put under a 64-byte run constraint; separate test exceeded the operator per-item capacity.
cases.observed: Run rejected/limit-exceeded and operator put rejected/quota-exceeded.

cases.stimulus: Clock-granted task scheduled an all-zero target absent from admission; a graph-scoped host separately scheduled a globally admitted component digest absent from the active manifest.
cases.observed: Both attempts rejected/not-admitted and neither wake record appeared.

cases.stimulus: Component-runner-granted task attempted a nested all-zero digest; a graph-scoped host separately targeted a globally admitted component absent from the active manifest.
cases.observed: Both rejected/not-admitted and no operation was created for either target.

cases.stimulus: Same nested target attempt without component-runner grant.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome rejected/not-granted before target resolution.

cases.stimulus: Key-service-granted task requested a handle absent from the native key store.
cases.observed: Terminal outcome rejected/not-found; no key bytes or handle inventory were exposed.

cases.stimulus: Stage request named a verified manifest but supplied a stale expected-active digest.
cases.observed: Stage rejected/conflict; active manifest stayed byte-for-byte unchanged and no activation record was created.

cases.expected_failure_code: not-granted before grant; transport-disabled after grant; limit-exceeded for timeout/destination preflight
cases.stimulus: All six typed methods, arbitrary destination, binary header, body and credential handle; zero/over-limit timeouts and overlong destination.
cases.observed: Every in-bound envelope returned transport-disabled without operation/persistence; timeout and destination bound escapes returned limit-exceeded first. Typed WIT prevents an undeclared method discriminant.

remaining_conformance_work: Malformed semantic factory documents remain the responsibility of their admitted schema-owning components; this native-focused tranche deliberately proves byte opacity rather than interpreting domain meaning.
Approval authenticity and replay are exercised through the compiled capability-router component with a focused Wasmtime adapter; the adapter is evidence, not a native policy substitute.
Exchange replay is component policy and is covered by the graph-level corpus rather than interpreted by native transport.
Behavioural equivalence, durability, successor lifecycle and independent-substrate portability are bound as separate focused reports by the aggregate release claim.
This report is a focused Sections 2 and 5 input. Its false local claim flag prevents it from acting as the aggregate claim authority and is not an open blocker.
